data.body: ADR 0013 review (task 16f1): No conflict for BLOCK or DEFER — both are merge-gate/continuation signals that do NOT modify any finding's severity field; Rule 11 is not triggered. DROP ruling overlaps structurally with the verifier's DROP (ADR 0013 prong 2), but ADR 0013 only authorizes code-reviewer-verifier, not code-reviewer-arbiter. Filed ticket 7edb-c652-b675-41a4 to amend ADR 0013 to explicitly cover code-reviewer-arbiter DROP authority. Amendment is not blocking this story.
